title: Train an RLM to reproduce decisive native schedules

donor_sources.observation: The donor dispatches dependency-ready waves but does not record thread interleavings or train a replay specialist.

mechanism: An RLM learns trace decomposition and schedule selection against deterministic replay of cooperative native cells.
challenge: Reproduce a failing interleaving after wall-clock delays change and reject a fabricated replay schedule.

title: Train an RLM to prove bounded executable equivalence

donor_sources.observation: The donor transforms ASTs without proving output equivalence or training a proof-decomposition policy.

mechanism: An RLM decomposes bounded bitvector equivalence obligations and learns from independent solver certificates or counterexamples.
challenge: An overflow-sensitive rewrite must yield a concrete differing input instead of an unsupported equivalence claim.

title: Train an RLM for reversible debugging of pure native cells

donor_sources.observation: The donor collects operation telemetry but provides no instruction-state rewind or trained reversible-debugging policy.

mechanism: An RLM learns where to checkpoint and rewind deterministic pure cells to isolate the first semantic divergence.
challenge: Rewind across a branch and reproduce values exactly; attempting to rewind an external effect must be refused.

title: Train an RLM to minimize native counterexamples structurally

donor_sources.observation: The donor extracts code structure but does not minimize behavioral witnesses while preserving a failure predicate.

mechanism: An RLM learns grammar-preserving reductions guided by an independent native failure-identity oracle.
challenge: A smaller crashing input with a different defect must not replace the original counterexample.

title: Train an RLM for executable change-impact slicing

donor_sources.observation: The donor analyzes workflow dependencies, not native data/control dependencies or learned change-impact slicing.

mechanism: An RLM learns semantic impact slices that drive targeted recompilation and qualification without missing affected contracts.
challenge: A changed branch predicate must invalidate a downstream result even when its direct call graph is unchanged.

title: Train an RLM to construct checkable loop resource certificates

donor_sources.observation: The donor checks basic workflow structure but does not prove termination or train certificate synthesis.

mechanism: An RLM proposes ranking functions and resource bounds that a small independent verifier checks for admitted loops.
challenge: Reject a decreasing-looking loop whose counter wraps and exceeds its claimed bound.

title: Train an RLM to synthesize pointer-free native host bindings

donor_sources.observation: The donor derives operation metadata from Python signatures but does not generate checked native host-handle bindings.

mechanism: An RLM learns typed handle interfaces and ownership adapters, qualified by adversarial lifetime and capability checks.
challenge: A stale or cross-kind handle must never resolve after slot reuse or code replacement.

title: Train an RLM to generate SIMD native batch kernels

donor_sources.observation: The donor transforms executable Python functions but does not generate vector instructions or establish scalar parity.

mechanism: An RLM learns vectorization and tail-handling choices for native batch cells using scalar-oracle rewards.
challenge: Tail lengths, misalignment, and unsupported ISA must preserve scalar semantics without out-of-bounds reads.

title: Train an RLM to autotune resident data layouts

donor_sources.observation: The donor uses Python column dictionaries for simplified analytics, not a native layout optimizer or a real DuckDB engine.

mechanism: An RLM learns array-of-structures, structure-of-arrays, and blocked layouts under exact semantics and migration constraints.
challenge: A faster layout must not lose concurrent writes or break external schema access.

title: Train an RLM to remove allocations through escape analysis

donor_sources.observation: The donor identifies structural syntax but does not prove lifetimes or optimize allocation placement.

mechanism: An RLM learns escape-analysis proposals whose independently checked ownership facts permit arena or stack rewrites.
challenge: A callback-retained reference must prevent temporary allocation placement even if ordinary tests return early.

title: Train an RLM to adapt native algorithms to allocation pressure

donor_sources.observation: The donor records operation timings and failures but does not learn native algorithm choices from memory-pressure feedback.

mechanism: An RLM learns guarded selection between memory-intensive and streaming native variants using measured pressure and verified outcomes.
challenge: Memory pressure must change the chosen algorithm without oscillation, lost results, or falsely claiming an allocation estimate is measured.

title: Train an RLM to reconstruct deoptimization state

donor_sources.observation: The donor forwards prior results between calls, but cannot reconstruct a suspended native frame into an interpreter continuation.

mechanism: An RLM learns precise native-to-IR state maps checked through forced deoptimization and suffix equivalence.
challenge: Every supported safepoint must reconstruct logical values and resume without duplicating completed effects.

title: Train an RLM for semantic incremental native compilation

donor_sources.observation: The donor caches AST descriptions and transforms whole registered tools, not semantic native dependency units.

mechanism: An RLM learns compilation-unit boundaries and reuse decisions checked against clean rebuilds of changed programs.
challenge: A semantic change hidden behind an unchanged symbol name must rebuild its dependent specialized code.

title: Train an RLM for generation-aware native source debugging

donor_sources.observation: The donor stores source and line-oriented structure but has no live native breakpoint mapping or trained debugging policy.

mechanism: An RLM learns generation-specific breakpoint and inspection actions using independently checked native failure localization.
challenge: A breakpoint must inspect the source and locals of its pinned generation despite a concurrent replacement.

title: Train an RLM for cross-compiler native qualification

donor_sources.observation: The donor selects answer replicas by judge or heuristics, not native executable behavior across independent compilers.

mechanism: An RLM learns compiler/configuration experiments that expose undefined behavior and qualify portable native rewrites.
challenge: Compiler agreement cannot accept a candidate that independently violates the oracle, and disagreement must remain unresolved.

title: Train an RLM to search native optimization phase orders

donor_sources.observation: The donor applies transformations in supplied list order without learning interactions or checking optimization outcomes.

mechanism: An RLM learns sequences of known native rewrite passes while equivalence and whole-program cost constrain search.
challenge: A phase order that wins microbenchmarks but regresses the complete executable must not be promoted.

title: Train an RLM for checked speculative native parallelization

donor_sources.observation: The donor runs declared parallel or dependency-ready calls but does not speculate over unknown native data dependencies.

mechanism: An RLM learns speculative partitions with transactional read/write validation and exact serial fallback.
challenge: A hidden dependency conflict must discard speculative state and reproduce the serial result without duplicated effects.

title: Train an RLM to optimize native precision under error contracts

donor_sources.observation: The donor supplies mathematical operations but does not learn native precision or reduction order under independently checked numerical-error limits.

mechanism: An RLM learns precision, summation, and vector reduction choices subject to explicit numerical error and stability contracts.
challenge: A fast reduction that fails catastrophic-cancellation or NaN behavior must be rejected despite ordinary-data gains.

title: Train an RLM for budgeted native compilation reuse

donor_sources.observation: The donor caches operation results by arguments and TTL, not executable artifacts with semantic identities and pinned generations.

mechanism: An RLM learns compilation-cache admission and eviction from reuse trajectories while code lifetime remains mechanically enforced.
challenge: An evicted artifact must never unmap active code; changed ABI or compiler semantics must prevent stale reuse.

title: Train an RLM for lossless logical code-cell checkpoints

donor_sources.observation: The donor retains Python locals in memory but does not serialize typed executable continuations or validate their restoration.

mechanism: An RLM learns logical-state checkpoint schemas and reconstruction programs checked by resumed execution equivalence.
challenge: Restore into different addresses without raw pointers, repeated effects, or changed suffix outputs.
